subject.why: The magic wand is immediately recognisable, complete with the requested golden star tip, white handle, pink ribbon, and sparkle trail.

category.why: There is a detached cast shadow rendered beneath the wand handle, implying an invisible floor plane rather than floating completely free in space.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters are present.

framing.why: The wand is centrally placed with generous margins on all sides and nothing is cropped.

colour.why: Vibrant, saturated purple background with good contrast against the white, yellow, and pink object.

detail.why: No micro-textures or excessive surface details; elements remain clean and stylized.

style.why: Rendered with smooth, chunky 3D volumes and a satin sheen that matches the reference cards.

fix: Remove the cast shadow beneath the wand so it floats cleanly in the air.
